arguments.text: Implemented evaluate in work.py: copy defaults; apply layers in order; reject layer keys outside defaults as unknown_key; when null_resets is exactly true, null restores that key's default; process non-empty request.environment only when policy.environment is exactly true; environment keys must be known and values must be strings, with exact lowercase true/false boolean parsing, signed decimal integer parsing, and unchanged strings; validate exact final types after all overrides, excluding bool from integer; failures return empty config. report.json matches requests.json under policy.json. Actual checks passed compilation, report equality, and boundary cases for false/zero/empty strings, null reset, later environment repair of an invalid layer value, exact types, and invalid environment syntax.
